*I* didn't want to get that anal about it. *I* was following up to
a post about not mixing card backs. My play group uses mixed backs (all
three versions) with no problem whatsoever. When I play in (non-sanctioned)
tournaments, I also don't care if anyone wishes to play mixed backs
(VtES/AH nor VtES/Jyhad). I was simply illustrating that "mixed card backs"
is no lnger a valid basis for disallowing Jyhad cards (unless you also
disallow AH).
